description.en:
Meant to turn a camera position and look-at point into distance and angles: [distance, horizontal angle, vertical angle], the angles in degrees. It is the inverse of GetDistRotCameraPos, and sysCamCtrlStep uses it for moves of type 1.
As decompiled, the function first returns [100.0, 0.0, 0.0] when dist < 99999999999999.0. Read literally, that covers every realistic distance, so the function would always return [100.0, 0.0, 0.0]. The constant looks like a decompilation artefact of a small threshold for nearly identical points; this was not checked against the compiled script.
Otherwise: the direction from _ref to _pos is normalised; the horizontal angle is atan2(x, z) and the vertical angle is atan2(y, horizontal length), both converted with RadToDeg.
No shipped event calls it, and CamCtrlMoveTo only queues moves of type 0.
[distance, horizontalDeg, verticalDeg], or [100.0, 0.0, 0.0] when the distance guard triggers (see the description).
